        ? 'Klik om afbeelding te vergroten: '

    function addAriaLabelsInSlider(root = document) {
        root.querySelectorAll('.photoGallerySlider-image').forEach(function (wrapper) {

            if (!link) return;

            let img = wrapper.querySelector('img');

            if (link.hasAttribute('aria-label')) return;

            let ariaText = enlargePrefix + altText;

    // Initieel uitvoeren
    addAriaLabelsInSlider();

    // Voor elke slider-container een observer
    document.querySelectorAll('.photoGallerySlider').forEach(slider => {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
            mutations.forEach(mutation => {
                mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
                    if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.classList.contains('photoGallerySlider-image')) {
                        addAriaLabelsInSlider(node);
                    }
                });
            });
        });

        observer.observe(slider, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });
    });
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  function waitForElementToExist(selector) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
        return resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
          resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, {
        subtree: true,
        childList: true,
      });
    });
  }

            childList: true,
            subtree: true
        });

      if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
        return resolve(document.querySelector(selector));

        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {

        });

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
        return resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (document.querySelector(selector)) {
          resolve(document.querySelector(selector));
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, {
        subtree: true,
